official.deadline_note: The Fiocruz call-page banner 'Encerra em 15/12/2026 17:00' marks the end of the whole selection process (final result due by 15 December 2026), not the application cut-off. Hard application cut-off: 16:00 Brasilia time, 23 October 2026, with no extension. Later milestones: homologated applications up to 03/11/2026, appeals on homologation 04/11/2026, merit analysis 09/11-02/12/2026, merit result up to 08/12/2026, appeals on merit 09/12/2026, final result up to 15/12/2026, scholarship implementation April 2027, overseas activities September/October 2027.
official.application_cycle: Edital Comite Gestor/FIOCRUZ no 02/2026, published 15 September 2026, under CAPES-Global.Edu Edital CAPES no 13/2025; applications 15/09/2026 10:00 to 23/10/2026 16:00 (Brasilia), for the 2027 activity cycle with overseas starts in September/October 2027
official.status_note: The Fiocruz Campus Virtual call page shows the edital as 'Edital aberto' (open) with the electronic form live from 15/09/2026 and closing 23/10/2026 at 16:00 Brasilia time; the page warns there will be no extension of the deadline.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Item 2.8 states that Fiocruz, the Network and CAPES do not cover administrative or academic fees (tuition fees) or research bench fees, and grant no help for companions or dependents; item 2.6 adds that CAPES will not cover any cost beyond the four items in 2.4.
benefits: Mensalidade, a monthly payment toward the grant holder's maintenance expenses in the destination country, proportional to the grant length - a 15-day grant receives half a monthly payment. For the Capacitação modality the published monthly rate is US$ 870.00 (Portaria CAPES no 1, de 3 de janeiro de 2020, Anexo I, Tabela 1 - Bolsas no Exterior).

Auxílio Deslocamento, toward round-trip economy-class promotional air tickets, paid in the currency used at the destination (Portaria no 1/2020, Anexo II, Tabela 1): US$ 550 South America, US$ 1,050 Europe, US$ 1,260 North America and Central America, US$ 1,300 Africa, US$ 1,730 Asia, US$ 2,240 Oceania.
Auxílio Instalação, a single payment at the start of the grant toward the grant holder's initial accommodation costs in the destination country.

Auxílio Seguro-saúde, toward health insurance with cover in the destination country; published value for a single grant holder US$ 90.00 (Portaria no 1/2020, Anexo IV, Tabela 1). Failure to buy the insurance leaves the grant holder in an irregular situation and the benefit must be returned, even where the destination has a public health system.

Total value published for budget purposes for this modality (Edital CAPES no 13/2025, Anexo VI): US$ 3,440.00 for a 15-day (0.5-month) grant and US$ 4,230.00 for a one-month grant, being the sum of monthly payment, high-cost-city additional, travel, installation and health-insurance items.

All four amounts are deposited by CAPES directly into the grant holder's bank account, and the benefits are granted exclusively to the grant holder regardless of family or salary status. Up to 6 grants: 4 of 15 days and 2 of one month.
eligibility: Be linked to a Fiocruz postgraduate programme that belongs to the Rede CAPES Global network and is tied to the Strategic Themes of Anexo I, either as teaching staff, researcher or technical professional with a formal (CLT or statutory) employment relationship with Fundacao Oswaldo Cruz and involved in postgraduate teaching, research, extension and internationalisation activities, or as a master's or doctoral student duly registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform.
Be Brazilian, or a foreign national with authorization to reside in Brazil and an issued CPF, and reside in Brazil (foreign applicants must present permanent residence authorization, CRNM and CPF).

Present proof of the training to be undertaken abroad, hold an ORCID record, not be in default with CAPES or any body of the public administration, and not have carried out studies abroad of the same nature or modality in the last 24 months.

Master's students must have completed at least one teaching period and doctoral students at least two at the time of application; students must not exceed the regulatory deadline for thesis/dissertation defence and must leave at least six months in Brazil to complete credits and defend.
Retired professionals are not eligible for scholarships under the CAPES-Global.Edu edital; volunteer or occasional collaboration work does not count as proof of formal employment.

Register in only one of the five editais offered by the Comite Gestor da Fiocruz - registering in more than one voids all applications without exception - and priority goes to candidates going to Global South or BRICS+ countries.
requirements: Submit the proposal exclusively through the electronic application form on the call page, with all mandatory documents as unlocked, legible PDFs, within the deadline.
If this is the candidate's first access to the Fiocruz site, register beforehand using the link on the application page (Acesso Fiocruz).

Choose a single modality among the five Fiocruz editais and a main Strategic Theme plus up to two alternatives, and accept the conditions of the Edital and of Portaria no 289/2018, from which no later ignorance may be claimed.
Demonstrate fluency in the language of the destination country or the working language accepted by the host institution, as required by CAPES even for Portuguese-speaking destinations.
Send supporting documentation for any equity criterion claimed (ethnic-racial belonging, person with a disability, gender in under-represented areas) at the time of application.
Declare any other scholarship received, observing the accumulation rules of Portaria no 133/2023 and Portaria CAPES no 187/2023.
documents: Anexo II - Plano de Atividade, maximum 5 pages, Times New Roman 12, PDF, aligned to one Strategic Theme, containing course name, 300-word summary, objectives and post-return goals, justification, methodology, infrastructure and timetable.
Anexo III - Qualificação da parceria internacional; Anexo IV - Autodeclaração de que não realizou atividades no exterior da mesma modalidade.
Official photo identification with CPF, or, for foreign nationals, CRNM and CPF issued by the Brazilian Federal Revenue with permanent residence authorization.

Proof of the training abroad: enrolment document on the foreign institution's letterhead with course name, description of activities, period and workload, or the acceptance letter of the training supervisor (Anexo VII); plus the institution's official acceptance letter on letterhead, dated and signed, with start and end month/year.

Anexo VIII - Declaração de fluência linguística signed by a supervisor or teacher abroad (or proof of proficiency under the CAPES proficiency requirements); updated Lattes curriculum link, or a free-format Vitae CV for technical candidates, covering the last five years (2022-2026), maximum 5 pages.

Anexo V - Carta de apoio do PPG e do orientador (discentes) or Anexo VI - Carta de apoio do PPG e da chefia plus proof of formal employment (profissionais); Anexo IX - Declaração de fluência linguística do orientador no Brasil (discentes); stamped and signed transcript; Anexo X - Autodeclaração de equidade; Anexo XI - Formulário de recurso.
selection_criteria: Technical analysis and homologation of applications: compliance with the requirements on the selection date and adequacy of the documentation to the call.

Merit analysis worth up to 100 points: Bloco 1 - Quality, relevance and impact of the proposal, up to 50 points (excellence and relevance of the work plan, institutional impact and strengthening of the Network/PPG, adherence to the Strategic Theme and Network goals, feasibility).

Bloco 2 - Academic merit and pertinence of the international partnership, up to 35 points (academic-scientific merit of the candidate, pertinence of the host institution and foreign supervision, whether the host is a partner institution).

Bloco 3 - Internationalisation and reduction of asymmetries, up to 15 points (link to a postgraduate programme based in the North, Northeast or Centre-West, strengthening of emerging programmes graded 3 or 4 by CAPES, destinations in the Global South and BRICS).
Additional equity score of a classificatory nature, up to 9 points, for ethnic-racial belonging, person with a disability and gender in under-represented areas.
Ties are broken by the higher Bloco 3 score, then Bloco 1, then Bloco 2, then by the older candidate; results are published as a ranked list on the Fiocruz Campus Virtual.
coverage: Mensalidade toward maintenance expenses in the destination country, proportional to the duration of the grant (half a monthly payment for the 15-day grants).
Auxílio Deslocamento toward round-trip economy-class promotional air tickets, paid in the currency practised at the destination.
Auxílio Instalação toward the initial accommodation expenses of the grant holder in the destination country, paid in a single instalment at the start of the grant.
Auxílio Seguro-saúde toward health insurance with cover in the destination country.
Expressly not covered: administrative and academic fees (tuition fees), research bench fees, and any assistance for companions or dependents.
application_method: Online application form published on the call page: https://formeditais.campusvirtual.fiocruz.br/formulario/cg-fiocruz-n-022026, accessed through Acesso Fiocruz.
First-time users must register previously at the link on the application page (acesso.fiocruz.br/inicio).
All mandatory documents uploaded as PDF, without password, legible and clearly visible, with the proposal finalised before the closing time.
Conditional, late, postal, fax or e-mail applications are not accepted; additional documents may be requested by Fiocruz or CAPES at any time.
official.application_route: Apply only through the Fiocruz Campus Virtual electronic form with an Acesso Fiocruz login, uploading all annexes as unlocked PDFs; one single application per candidate.
official.study_mode: In-person (presencial) training abroad; the call does not publish a full-time or part-time label.
official.citizenship_residency: Brazilian, or foreign national with authorization to reside in Brazil and an issued CPF; the candidate must reside in Brazil, and foreign nationals must present permanent residence authorization (CRNM and CPF).
official.international_eligibility: Open to Brazilian citizens and to foreign nationals resident in Brazil with an issued CPF and residence authorization; the mobility is outbound from Brazil to an overseas host institution under CAPES-Global.Edu.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The candidate must be linked to a Fiocruz postgraduate programme attached to one of the five Strategic Themes of the Rede CAPES Global (Anexo I): 01 Health systems, socially determined diseases and inequalities; 02 Global health and health emergencies; 03 Biodiversity, environment and climate change; 04 Life cycle, demographic transformations and healthy ageing; 05 Innovation in health science and technology. One main theme plus up to two alternatives are chosen at application. Capacitação linguística (language training) is expressly excluded from this modality.
official.research_requirement: A Plano de Atividade (Anexo II, maximum 5 pages) aligned to a Strategic Theme, with course name, 300-word summary of activities, objectives and post-return goals, justification for the internationalisation of the Fiocruz postgraduate programme, methodology, infrastructure at the host and a timetable; plus proof of the training and the host institution's acceptance letter.
official.duration: 15 days (4 vacancies) or 1 month (2 vacancies), up to 6 grants, with overseas activities starting in September and October 2027; CAPES Edital no 13/2025 sets the modality's validity between 15 days and 3 months.
official.description: The Comitê Gestor da Fiocruz, part of the Rede CAPES Global para o Desenvolvimento Sustentável, Ciência e Saúde, opens a call for scholarships in the Capacitação de curta duração no Exterior modality under the CAPES-Global.Edu Programme, CAPES Edital no 13/2025. Its main objective is individual improvement and institutional strengthening through the qualification of people working at Fiocruz by means of technical, scientific or pedagogical training abroad, excluding language training, with activities abroad starting in September and October 2027.
official.region: Brazil (catalogue region: Latin America); destinations include partner institutions in the Global South, Europe, North America and elsewhere listed in Anexo I
official.program_type: Short-term training abroad scholarship (Capacitação de curta duração no Exterior) of the CAPES-Global.Edu institutional internationalisation programme, run by the Fiocruz Managing Committee
official.english_requirement: No IELTS or TOEFL score is published. CAPES requires proof of fluency in the language of the destination country or the working language accepted by the host institution, through a declaration signed by a supervisor or teacher abroad (Anexo VIII), demanded even when the destination is a Portuguese-speaking country; alternatively the candidate may prove proficiency under the CAPES proficiency requirements document. Students additionally need a linguistic-fluency declaration from their Brazilian supervisor (Anexo IX).

not_confirmed: Auxílio Instalação amount for the Capacitação modality (Portaria CAPES no 1/2020, Anexo III, Tabela 1 - the value row could not be read from the official catalogue text)
The percentage of the high-cost-city additional used to build the Anexo VI budget totals for this modality
The final number of grants actually implemented, which depends on the CAPES scholarship calendar and budget
verification.notes: Read the full Fiocruz Edital CG 02/2026 PDF and Anexo I from the call page, plus the CAPES-Global.Edu programme page on gov.br with Edital no 13/2025 and its Anexo VI (financial items for overseas grants) and Portaria CAPES no 1/2020 in the CAPES norms catalogue. The Fiocruz call page itself publishes no figure: it states that the amounts follow Portaria CAPES no 1/2020 and are paid by CAPES. The amount reported here is the awarding agency's own published total for exactly this modality (Capacitação, 15 days = US$ 3,440.00; one month = US$ 4,230.00), and the US$ 870.00 monthly rate, regional travel allowance and US$ 90.00 health-insurance values come from Portaria no 1/2020 annexes. Deadline, eligibility, documents, scoring, visa and post-grant duties were taken from the Fiocruz edital text.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an internal Fiocruz call, not an open competition: you must already be a Fiocruz master's or doctoral student on Sucupira, or a staff member with a formal CLT/statutory contract, and your programme must sit inside one of the five Rede CAPES Global strategic themes. Six short grants are on offer - four of 15 days and two of one month - and CAPES pays a monthly stipend, airfare, an installation allowance and health insurance directly into your account, so the money covers living abroad rather than any tuition. Applications run from 15 September to 16:00 Brasilia time on 23 October 2026 for training that only begins in September or October 2027, so you need roughly a year of lead time for visas and leave. Read the five Fiocruz editais before you touch the form, because entering a second one cancels every application you have made.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Fiocruz master's or doctoral students and CLT/statutory staff whose work maps onto one of the five Rede CAPES Global strategic themes and who need a short, funded technical or scientific course at a named overseas institution.
application_readiness_checklist: Decide which single one of the five Comitê Gestor editais you will enter before registering - a second registration voids them all, and only your first submission counts if you applied to an earlier call.

Chase the two documents that always arrive last: the host institution's acceptance letter on letterhead (name, description, start/end month-year) and the Anexo VIII language declaration signed by a supervisor or teacher abroad, which CAPES demands even for Portuguese-speaking destinations.

Ask your postgraduate coordinator (and your sector head if you are staff) for the Anexo V or VI support letter early - it must also state your regulatory defence deadline and the credits you already hold.

Confirm you are clear on scholarship accumulation and on the CAPES ceilings of 48 months for doctorate and 24 months for master's, which count Brazilian scholarships, earlier programmes and overseas internships.

Build the Plano de Atividade to the letter: maximum five pages, Times New Roman 12, PDF, with the four 300-word blocks (summary, objectives with post-return goals, justification, methodology), the host infrastructure and a timetable.

Submit several days before 16:00 Brasilia time on 23 October 2026 and keep the confirmation; unfinished proposals at the cut-off are excluded and the Committee accepts no responsibility for technical problems.
common_rejection_risks: Registering in more than one of the five Fiocruz editais, or submitting a second application after an earlier call - both cancel every candidature without exception.
Missing the 16:00 Brasilia cut-off on 23 October 2026 or leaving the submission unfinished; the call states there will be no extension of the deadline.

Uploaded PDFs that are password-protected or unreadable, letters that are not on letterhead, dated and signed with the signatory's e-mail and phone, or start and end dates that do not match a 15-day or 30-day grant.
Students past their regulatory defence deadline, or with fewer than six months left in Brazil to finish credits and defend.
Retired professionals, who are not eligible under CAPES-Global.Edu, and candidates in default with CAPES or any public administration body.
Claiming an equity criterion in the form without attaching the supporting document (affirmative-action evidence, medical report with CID/CIF, or the Anexo X self-declaration).
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition, administrative and academic fees, research bench fees, the visa and passport, any costs for accompanying family members, and any stay beyond the granted period are all on you; the call expressly excludes tuition/bench fees and dependants, and no companion allowance exists. Only US$ 870 per month (half for 15-day grants) is the living stipend, so a high-cost host city will need top-up funds.
document_audit: Foreign-host letters must be on letterhead and carry the institution's full name (with campus, faculty, institute or branch where relevant), complete address, institutional website and contact phone.
The language proof must be signed by a supervisor or teacher abroad (Anexo VIII); for students a separate declaration from the Brazilian supervisor is also needed (Anexo IX).
The proof of the training must name the course, describe the activities, and give the period and the planned workload - a plain acceptance e-mail is not one of the accepted options.
The Lattes curriculum is submitted as a link inside the form (or as a free-format CV for technical staff), limited to five pages and covering 2022-2026.
Documents must be PDF without a password; letters and transcripts need dates, stamps and signatures, and the transcript must be stamped and signed by the institution.
Equity documents must be filed with the application itself, not after the result, because the equity score is classificatory and awarded at application time.
alerts: Only one of the five Comitê Gestor editais may be entered; multiple registrations are cancelled automatically and without exception.
The portal banner 'Encerra em 15/12/2026' is the end of the selection process, not the application deadline - the real cut-off is 16:00 Brasilia time on 23 October 2026.
Overseas activities start only in September/October 2027 and the grant is implemented in April 2027, so start the visa, leave and acceptance-letter processes almost a year ahead.
CAPES does not accept a tourism visa, and the visa type cannot be changed during the grant - you must hold the correct student visa for the whole stay.

After returning you must stay in Brazil for the same length as the grant, file a detailed report with a completion certificate within 30 days, acknowledge CAPES funding in any output (finance code 001), and supply a 60-second video and a five-sentence text for dissemination.
Health insurance is compulsory even where the destination has a public health system; without proof of purchase the benefit must be repaid to CAPES.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register or log in to Acesso Fiocruz, complete the single electronic form for CG-Fiocruz-02/2026 uploading every annex as an unlocked PDF, submit once, then follow homologation, merit and final results on the call page; appeals are raised with the signed Anexo XI sent by gov.br to rede.capesglobal@fiocruz.br.
